title: Elm media wall with electric fire
description: A full-width media wall built around a 75-inch screen: a framed, backlit TV panel between acoustic slats, a long electric fire under a soundbar shelf, and lit open shelving at both ends.

title: Dark kitchen with walnut island
description: A dark handleless kitchen with a walnut island lit from below, glass-fronted wall units and a full-height stone splashback.

title: Walnut kitchen, black marble splashback
description: An L-shaped walnut kitchen with a black marble-effect splashback, tall oven housing and a lit open display column by the door.

title: Cream and walnut fitted bedroom
description: Wall-to-wall cream wardrobes with walnut trim, an overbed storage run with a lit slatted headboard, and matching bedsides.

title: Alcove shelving and fireplace wall
description: Lit open shelving and cupboards built into both alcoves, with a slatted TV panel above the fireplace.

title: Charcoal wardrobes around the bed
description: Floor-to-ceiling charcoal wardrobes with a bridging overbed unit and a slatted, lit recess for the bed.

title: Black shaker kitchen with marble island
description: Black shaker cabinetry with a marble-effect island and matching full-height splashback, opening onto the garden.

title: Oak and cashmere fitted bedroom
description: Cashmere wardrobes either side of the bed, bridged by an oak overbed unit with an open shelf, in oak-framed carcasses from floor to ceiling.

title: Walnut media unit by the stairs
description: A walnut base unit with a marble-effect TV wall and a lit open shelf run overhead, fitted into the space by the staircase.

title: Loft bedroom with eaves storage
description: A loft conversion fitted with wardrobes under the eaves and a desk with drawers built across the window wall.
